mapper.select: select role_code, role_name, data_scope, perms, is_using from cbs.t_role order by role_code asc
mapper.insert: insert into cbs.t_role (role_code, role_name, data_scope, perms, is_using) values (#{r.role_code}, #{r.role_name}, #{r.data_scope}, #{r.perms, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, #{r.is_using})
mapper.update: update cbs.t_role set is_using = #{is_using} where role_code = #{roleCode}
mapper.select: select count(*) from cbs.t_user where role_code = #{roleCode} and is_using = true
